API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIFile Type Control PolicyCustom File Type Resource Get Custom File Type By ID
Custom File Type Resource Get Custom File Type By ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/customFileTypes/:id

Retrieves information about a custom file type based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
int32
REQUIRED

Custom file type ID

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

Custom file type ID. This ID is assigned and maintained exclusively for custom file types, and this value is different from the file type ID (i.e., fileTypeId field).

name
string

Custom file type name

extension
string

Specifies the file type extension. The maximum extension length is 10 characters. Existing Zscaler extensions cannot be added to custom file types.

description
string

Additional information about the custom file type, if any.

fileTypeId
int32

File type ID. This ID is assigned and maintained for all file types including predefined and custom file types, and this value is different from the custom file type ID.
